flags: DROP CANDIDATE (private, Google): Google Maps 'Camp On the Heart' 3.9 from 65 reviews - under 4.0 with 25+ reviews. Quoted reviews read: 'a year ago ... this is a whole different level of gross. Spots are positioned close enough that if you stretch a bit, you can pick your neighbor's nose' (1/5); 'a year ago ... Stayed for a month and for $500 includes W/S/E/G ... Office open 7.5hrs a week' (3/5); '7 years ago ... The camp is mainly long term so the camp spots are set up as small yards' (3/5); Tripadvisor '7 years ago ... Most of the people there are long term residents' (1/5). RV Life lists it with stars 4 / $$ (stored) and avg_rate 32; no RV Life review count read.

LONG-STAY / WORKFORCE: long-stay in character. Neither operator page (Fisher Group) nor the CVB listing posts a nightly rate; no booking engine. The CVB listing reads 'Open year round for overnight and temporary campground ... Office hours: Mon, Wed, Thurs 4:30pm-6pm.' Imagery: the north half (~46.8725,-102.8077) is ~40 rows of skirted long-term units; the south half (~46.8708,-102.8084) holds ~25 RV sites under trees. Nightly share not countable (no site map or rates); the reviews describe a mainly long-term park. Test 2 (posted nightly rate) fails; the only price is camper reports ($30 a night, Campendium, reported 2023-07-06; RV Life avg_rate 32), which can't price it. Read together with the 3.9 Google rating: mostly seasonal/long-term AND iffy -> drop candidate.
PRICE: no operator rate. Camper report $30 (2023) and RV Life avg $32 would pass the $50 gate if it stood.

WATERFRONT (stored riverview, not --AWH): stands. The outer RV row of the south section sits ~40-55 m from the Heart River (~30 m channel) with the campground's own perimeter dirt road and an open grassy bank between; the loop road blocks on-water. The north long-term rows are 60-150 m off. Earlier evidence's 'short-term (nomad) section with the best river views' isn't stated on any current page (dropped from the note).

PIN: stored 46.87250,-102.80880 sits in the empty field west of the north rows; north rows' centroid ~46.8725,-102.8077 (~90 m), south RV section ~46.8708,-102.8084 (~190 m); Google 46.87002,-102.80948 is at the entrance by the bridge. No move (under 250 m).
